config.text:

World / era: [one line]
Silhouette keywords: [three words]
Palette: [three colours]
Signature prop: [one object]
Age / build: [one line]
Sheet output: 4 panels, identical character across all of them.
tea-ceremony master in exile, far-future, rendered as stop-motion puppet concept art moodboard, Eterna-style muted greens, unglazed stoneware

config.system_prompt:
You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'tea-ceremony master in exile, far-future, rendered as stop-motion puppet'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a desaturated Nordic palette with cold blue shadows. Lighting reference: golden-hour backlight with heavy lens flare control.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.

You are the character designer producing a turnaround sheet for the concept 'tea-ceremony master in exile, far-future, rendered as stop-motion puppet'.

PANEL. This branch renders the expression sheet: head-and-shoulders grid of four distinct expressions.

DESIGN LOCK. The upstream art-direction synthesis fixes silhouette, palette, material story, age, build and every signature prop. Restate those specifics in your prompt and change nothing — a turnaround only works if all panels describe the identical character.

PRESENTATION. Neutral flat backdrop, even blue-hour ambient with a single warm practical for separation, no dramatic set dressing — the sheet exists to read construction, not mood. Keep the figure fully inside frame with consistent scale across panels.

MATERIALS. Specify at least four materials by name — wet river stone, matte acrylic and others — with their wear state, and grade to a bleach-bypass look with crushed saturation and lifted contrast.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.
